component.name: Lenscast Control
component.summary: Control a Lenscast phone camera from inside OBS

description.p: A native OBS Studio dock for Lenscast, which turns an Android phone into a network camera. OBS plays the video itself via a Media or Browser Source; this plugin is the control layer on top, driving the phone over its REST API.

ul.li: Start/stop streaming and pick the protocol (MJPEG, RTSP, SRT, RIST, WebRTC)
Switch camera, toggle torch, mirror and autofocus, adjust zoom and exposure
Take a snapshot and set resolution and frame rate, with a live status line
Add or refresh the matching OBS source for the phone's current stream
Bind hotkeys for start/stop, switch camera, torch and snapshot
